mentions.name: CORS Proxy
mentions.description: This project is a CORS proxy built to correctly handle credentials and secrets, allowing static-first apps to access real APIs without running into CORS restrictions. It aims to change the stigma that CORS proxies are only for fetching undocumented APIs.
mentions.problem: CORS proxies carry a stigma of being used mainly for fetching undocumented APIs, discouraging their legitimate use for accessing real APIs from static-first apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Currently building a CORS Proxy.

After working on it for a while, I noticed there’s a stigma around using CORS proxies, often associated with fetching undocumented APIs.
